## Decision

The CLI root-resolution rule is CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR ?? process.cwd(); findGitRoot has no role. The hook three-step precedence (payload cwd → CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR → process.cwd()) reduces to two steps at the CLI tier because the CLI never receives a payload cwd.

## Rationale

hooks/ledger.mjs:790 uses CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR || process.cwd(); stop-gate.ts:1101-1106 uses inp.cwd || CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR || process.cwd(). findGitRoot misresolves in two cases: (1) monorepo — walks above a package boundary when CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR points to a package; (2) git worktree — existsSync matches .git file and returns the worktree root not the main repo root.
